test_ipc_reader: test the IpcReader class to read .feather IPC files from a directory using a glob pattern
test_ipc_stream_reader: test the IpcReader class to read .arrow IPC stream files from a directory with stream mode enabled
create_ipc_reader: create an IpcReader instance pointing to a directory with a glob pattern to filter IPC files
run_ipc_reader: run the IpcReader to iterate over documents extracted from IPC/Feather or Arrow stream files
check_same_data: check that documents returned by IpcReader match the original IPC file rows including text, id, and metadata
